{{Quote|Grab those refugees out of there.|The Imperial officer|<ref name="LotL" />}}
An '''Imperial officer''' was present on [[Nixus Hub 218]]<ref name="LotL" /> in [[3 BBY]].<ref name="Date">''[[Star Wars: Timelines]]'' dates the events of "[[Legends of the Lasat]]" to [[3 BBY]].</ref> He led an operation to capture two [[Lasat]] refugees, [[Gron]] and [[Chava]], after being tipped off by the [[pirate]] [[Hondo Ohnaka]]. However, Ohnaka had also informed his friend, the rebel [[Ezra Bridger]], a member of the [[Spectres]], of the refugees, so they arrived just in time to attack and take out the officer and his [[stormtrooper]]s, Ezra personally stunning the officer with his [[Ezra Bridger's first lightsaber|lightsaber-blaster]]. The Spectres and Ohnaka hid the unconscious officer and his troopers inside the same cargo container that [[Gron]] and [[Chava]] had been hiding in.<ref name="LotL" />
